characters.name: 钳卫
characters.prompt:
Produce a beautiful, art-directed ORIGINAL enemy character design for the side-scrolling game PELICAN 429. The provided pelican image is a STYLE reference only: match its polished stylized 3D game-art finish, appealing sculpted forms, restrained smooth materials and strongly readable silhouette. Do not depict the pelican. This is a COMPLETE VISUAL REDESIGN, with the quality of a premium animated science-fiction adventure game character. It should look deliberately designed, sophisticated, memorable and attractive, like an excellent sculpted collectible rendered for a game. Strong shape rhythm: a few elegant continuous outer armor surfaces, compact believable robotics inside, carefully chosen areas of negative space, small precise mechanical accents. Soft satin ceramic/composite, deep translucent optical glass, fine machined joints, very controlled tiny emissive elements. RICH shape design and material transitions, NOT busy surface detail. Realistic hard-surface construction with STYLIZED, agile, confident proportions. Contemporary robotics evolved into near-future game design; the technology is visible in precise articulated mechanisms and functional sensors. No rust, no dirt, no random bolts, no boxy generic factory machinery, no skeleton of black cylinders, no rows of LED strips, no bland product-catalog lighting.
Layout: one landscape character design sheet, a LARGE MAIN standing/hovering pose on left taking 60% area, a small front/back pair in upper right and one action pose in lower right. Main and action poses have a RIGHT-FACING SIDE-SCROLLER orientation, near-flat SIDE PROFILE with camera only 5 degrees off side to reveal volume, no overhead view. Keep same character in all views. Main silhouette points unambiguously right, full body visible, generous framing. All four depictions match exactly in design and proportions. Background simple warm ivory, subtle floor shadow, studio key light with a delicate cyan rim, no scenery, no UI, no text, no labels, no logos. Primary attention on the large character, secondary views much smaller. The result must be a beautiful character first, with a clear orthographic-like lateral silhouette suited to gameplay.
Design an athletic compact BIPED HUMANOID interceptor descended from Optimus-type general-purpose robots. Appealing 5.5-head-tall proportions, small helmet-like black glass sensor head, neatly tapered torso and waist, slightly larger forearms and feet for a game silhouette, streamlined continuous limbs. Porcelain-white chest flows into glossy deep-navy shoulder shells; muted teal inset on torso, one warm amber sensor behind face glass. Clean integrated near-side forearm work CLAMP is signature: two smooth curved pearl-white jaws with navy padded interiors, a compact visible linear actuator, restrained amber contacts, resembles an advanced precision manipulator not a crab hand, gun or hammer. Other hand slim articulated metallic fingers. The clamp is carried forward/down so its silhouette shows in profile. Continuous designed thigh/shin covers separated by small precise titanium joint rings, not flat armor plates strapped on a skeleton. A subtle backward crest to sensor helmet and upward chest curve give character and alertness. Stance agile: slightly bent knees, one foot forward, inclined attentive posture. Elegant, confident, slightly imposing; NEVER a chibi or bulky medieval soldier. Action pose: low lunge with clamp raised behind shoulder preparing a forward swipe. Colors 60% pearl white, 25% ink navy, 10% desaturated teal, 5% amber/titanium accents.
